patch_description:
The validation failure was caused by the recursive implementation corrupting row identity and column mappings. In particular, rows were written into `result_df` using completion order from `as_completed`, an artificial `original_index` column was added and later manipulated, recursion could rebuild frames without their original labels, and the method always returned an empty column-ordering list. The final sort also separated the returned data from any row-specific ordering information.

This replacement preserves every original cell, row, column, and index. It builds bounded candidate field orderings using serialized values only for scoring, evaluates candidates with the exact sorted-string LCP objective, and returns valid per-row column orderings. Missing values are normalized only for scoring; stored values are never changed.
